title: Generalized Hierarchical Bayesian Segmentation with Irregular Designs, Multi-Sequence Hierarchies, and Grouped/Latent-Group Designs

protected_scientific_direction.description: BayesBreak remains a generalized hierarchical Bayesian multiple-changepoint method based on segment marginal likelihoods, with irregular designs, multiple related sequences, known groups, and finite latent groups as central components.
protected_scientific_direction.template: SAIM Unified Professional Template v1.0, Computer Modern Sans

scientific_corrections.change: Separated admissible-partition support from observed segment marginal likelihoods; zero likelihood no longer changes the prior normalizing set.
scientific_corrections.effect: Clarifies the probability model without changing the estimator or any archived result.

scientific_corrections.change: Defined the reported quantity as m_star(theta)=m(theta;d_star) when the conditional mean depends on exposure or trial structure.
scientific_corrections.effect: Distinguishes a scientific reporting scale from observation-specific exposure.

scientific_corrections.change: Retained the one-dimensional integral and removed unsupported universal monotonicity and routine-wide convergence-rate language.
scientific_corrections.effect: Exactness and approximation statements now match the available derivation and numerical checks.

scientific_corrections.change: Separated the sum-product result from the max-sum/backtracking result and corrected storage/output complexity statements.
scientific_corrections.effect: Prevents marginal posterior summaries from being conflated with the joint MAP partition.

scientific_corrections.change: Stated the conditions under which coordinatewise posterior decisions minimize additive or Hamming loss.
Corrected the fixed-count Poisson interval-occupancy factor to local odds exp(Lambda_j)-1.
scientific_corrections.effect: Aligns the prior formula with conditioning on the number of occupied intervals.

scientific_corrections.change: Aligned the Jensen-minorized criterion with the implementation-scale group weight, including n_g log gamma_u(i,j).
scientific_corrections.effect: Matches the stated coordinate-ascent objective to the implemented scoring convention.

scientific_corrections.change: Tightened assumptions, removed unsupported method-specific rates, and bounded normalized-distribution error by min(1, exp(2 eta)-1).
scientific_corrections.effect: Limits the theorem to consequences implied by a verified uniform segment log-score bound.

scientific_corrections.change: Specified maximum-cardinality, minimum-total-distance one-to-one matching and NA when no match exists.

incomplete_items: One routine-specific nonconjugate approximation-rate statement remains a proof obligation and is not used as an established rate result.
The EP logistic-normal comparison did not complete under the 20-second per-test cap; it is unresolved rather than failed.
The previously identified latent-group returned-objective/restart-selection defect was not repaired because package-code changes were outside this manuscript phase.
Corrected array-CGH comparator and methylation posterior-predictive computations were not run.
Independent external changepoint annotations are not available for the applied studies.
The final journal venue, permanent software repository, and data-release locations remain unset.
